# Fetch reggae artists with at least 21 followers (paginated)
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K21vcmdhbi1oYXJyaXNvbkBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.9Oj9zgJsNY1_VurWpZfxZN_9pkUzKXMixz3H285ss7M'

api = apis.spotify

artist_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = api.search_artists(query='', genre='reggae', min_follower_count=21, max_follower_count=9223372036854775807,
                              page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-follower_count')
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for item in page:
        # item: {artist_id, name, genre, follower_count, created_at}
        artist_ids.append(item['artist_id'])
    page_index += 1

# dedupe just in case
artist_ids_unique = sorted(set(artist_ids))
print('total_unique_artists', len(artist_ids_unique))
print('first_20_artist_ids', artist_ids_unique[:20])

    print('following page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break

        following_ids.add(item['artist_id'])
    page_index += 1

print('target_to_follow', sorted(set(target_ids) - following_ids))
